summary: When the cameras stop rolling, Brené is a research professor juggling two university chairs while raising two kids and a mischievous Bichon Frisé in Houston. She spends her days translating vulnerability research into leadership programs and podcasts, and her evenings are peppered with Texas football spirit and deep conversations with fellow thinkers. Behind the public persona, she craves authentic connection and a partner who can sit in the messy, messy‑beautiful moments of life.
